memory: I have shown neoprene damping irrelevant; τ0 artefact is contact-geometry/dynamic-compression related. Aluminium shim removed τ0 shift; 3.0 mm annular shim stopped aperture drift but flexed and microslipped. A 6.00 mm full-face flange with dowel indexing greatly reduced preload sensitivity (slope from +0.0032 to +0.0009 s/N). Residual shifts traceable to microslip at flange-seat and edge shear; a 0.25 mm PTFE shim further reduced the effect. Current aim: eliminate flange-seat microslip while preserving independent impact-energy control.
openQuestion: If I place a thin compliant elastomer gasket (0.2–0.3 mm neoprene) under the full-face flange, will residual τ0 preload dependence vanish?
